note: The You Are the Commission rigged instrument (Room M2, THE BULLDOZER). Three parcel dossiers drawn from the documented categories the renewal plan condemned; each is a described composite of a documented building type, labeled as such on screen, never a fabricated address. The checklist mirrors the plan's own vocabulary.

parcels.title: A converted kitchenette building
parcels.described: A fair-era six-flat cut into single rooms, hot plates in closets, one bath to a floor, the fire escape long gone. The type the plan photographed first.
parcels.typeNote: described composite of a documented building type

parcels.title: A well-kept six-flat, fully occupied
parcels.described: Structurally sound, taxes paid, gardens out front. Its tenants are the neighborhood's newest Black arrivals. The plan's surveys scored age and density, not upkeep.
parcels.typeNote: described composite of a documented building type

parcels.title: The Fifty-Seventh Street art colony storefronts
parcels.described: Wood storefronts from the fair itself, studios and shops for sixty years. Old, dense, and mixed use, which is all the checklist needed.
parcels.typeNote: a documented place, described from the record

verdict.protectResult: No statutory basis. The checklist recognizes no reason to keep a building.
verdict.lesson: The checklist was written so that anything old, dense, or mixed could be condemned. That describes nearly every city block and almost no suburb, which was the point.
